author: RATTLEWARRIOR
body:
Hello, i am reporting the player Cuish, for an illegal modification(fancy i know), usually known as "togglesneak". Recently, Cuish has had problems of his browser and minecraft crashing. he gave me and a few others the crash report log. file:///home/chronos/u-ffece95fa56cc64da4201a44ac7a3c4fe563d7c1/Downloads/crash-2017-05-24_16.46.00-client.txt This is the log he gave me. Now, if you scroll down, you will come to what looks like his "mods folder" or where he puts his mods. He uses Keystrokes, reimap, status effects, and some more "usuall mods. But at the very bottom i see this UCHIJA ToggleSneak{3.0} [ToggleSneak] (ToggleSneak-(1.7.10)-v3.0.jar) this means he is using a "togglesneak" Jar. it is is 1.7.10 alike all the other mods he uses. Now, you are probably wondering Well its only bannable if he can skean while in his iinventory, but i know exactly that he can shift while in his inventory. I have asked him questions in discord about being in inventory while sneaking. he says that the mod allows you to do that. I do not know if he is actually using it, but i am pretty sure that even if it is caught on your screen, it is bannable. but i might be wrong, that could be tourney rules only. I do not know if the picture below is enough evidence.


I do not know if this is enough to get someone banned, and i do not want to see someone be banned, but i dont feel right keeping a secret that could end up being bad.
Thanks

-Rattle

replies.author: InputIGNHere
replies.body:
{tag=7fd8f1058d10483e87fe5e5ed4d40a5c} This evidence is not enough for a punishment. There is no evidence that he even uses the modification. The pictures you show us only tell us he has the modification "togglesneak". Correct evidence would be: The player being recorded using it in a GUI. The pictures with the crash report report nothing else besides:
  • An error
  • A list of mods: 
    • MCP, FML, Forge, PlayerAPI, bspkrsCore, ArmorStatusHUD, StatusEffectHUD, keymod, Key Strokes Mod, Motion Blur Mod, Rei's Minimap, TimeChanger, and ToggleSneak. 
  • System Specs
